title: What If Earth's Magnetic Field Vanished? It Would Be Bad, Not a Disaster Movie

scenes.text: What if Earth's magnetic field disappeared? Not the movie version. The real one is stranger.
First, every compass stops working. The field also shields the planet from the solar wind, and that shield would be gone.
Auroras would spread to far lower latitudes, glowing over places that never see them.
Radiation at ground level would rise, with more cancer-causing ultraviolet. Satellites would glitch and power grids would be at risk.
Mars lost its field about 4 billion years ago and most of its atmosphere. But Venus has no field and a huge atmosphere.
So scientists say: serious, not apocalyptic. And the field isn't going anywhere for billions of years.

description:
What if Earth's magnetic field vanished? Compasses would fail, auroras would spread toward the equator, ground radiation would rise and satellites and power grids would be at risk.
Scientists say it would be problematic but not necessarily apocalyptic in the short term, since Venus keeps a thick atmosphere without a magnetic field, and Earth's field is not expected to disappear for billions of years.
